column2: a chunky crate-built giant robot (the Crate Titan) made of stacked orange and grey cargo crates with a glowing round core in its chest, standing upright, arms down at its sides, thick blocky legs, seen from a front three-quarter view

a small red wooden ice-fishing hut with a slanted snowy roof and a stovepipe, standing on a round slab of cracked sea ice with a fishing hole and a wooden sled beside it, all one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view

a snowy mountain peak in miniature with a glowing blue ice-cave arch carved into its base and a small stone prayer-flag shrine on a ledge, one compact sculpted massif, seen from an elevated three-quarter view

a volcanic forge tower: a tall stone foundry with three thick chimneys, a big arched furnace mouth, a chunky lava channel running from its base, iron bands and a chain lift on one side, one compact building, seen from an elevated three-quarter view

a wooden swamp stilt house on thick posts with a sloped tin roof, a wrap-around porch, hanging paper lanterns, a short dock with a small airboat moored to it, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view

a cliff-top airship dock: a chunky stone tower on a rock pinnacle with a wooden dock arm and a crane, and a small round airship with a fabric balloon moored to the dock, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view

a tide-pool coral arch: a big rounded coral archway with branching coral clusters on top, a small stone shrine under the arch on a sandbar, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view

a walking brass automaton: a tall four-legged brass machine with a boiler body, big gears on its sides, a smokestack and a small cab on top, legs straight and clearly separated, standing still, seen from a front three-quarter view

a domed stone observatory on a small rocky hilltop with a big brass telescope poking out of an open dome slit, a fallen meteor rock beside it, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view

a stepped jungle temple pyramid with a stone stair up the front, a doorway shrine on top, and a big stone guardian head carved into its side, chunky vines over the stones, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view
a giant alien mushroom tree with a wide glowing cap, a twisted thick stem and a cluster of tall crystal spires around its roots, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view
a giant ancient stone head half buried in sand, with two broken stone arches behind it and a low ruined wall, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view

a night-market street gate: a wooden paifang-style archway with a curved tiled roof, two market stalls under awnings on either side with hanging signs and lanterns, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view
a floating rock islet with grass on top and a small waterfall spilling off one side, a big ring gate standing on the islet, one compact object, seen from an elevated three-quarter view
